file_video.title: Video File URL (Direct Download & Clip Extraction)
file_video.description: Direct URL to a video file (.mp4, .mkv, .mov, .webm, etc.) to download and analyze locally. Mutually exclusive with 'youtube_url' (provide one or the other, not both). When specified, downloads the video, detects salient moments, cuts the video into clips, and populates 'download_url' with the clip link while 'Download Link' is null.

youtube_url.title: YouTube Video URL ($)
youtube_url.description: Valid YouTube video or VOD URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..., https://youtu.be/...). Mutually exclusive with 'file_video' (provide one or the other, not both). When specified, analyzes YouTube transcripts and populates 'Download Link' with the YouTube timestamp link while 'download_url' is empty. Extra-cost for proxy usage will be charged

max_clips.title: Maximum Clips
max_clips.description: Number of top highlight segments to return, sorted by engagement score.

max_length.title: Maximum Clip Length (seconds)
max_length.description: Maximum duration in seconds of each selected highlight clip (including context buffers). Optimized for YouTube Shorts (e.g. 60s).

targetFormat.title: Target Video Format (Social Media MP4)
targetFormat.description: Target aspect ratio and resolution for the generated MP4 clips (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, etc.).
enumTitles: Original Aspect Ratio - No Crop (Source Resolution)

burn_subtitles.title: Burn-in Animated Subtitles
burn_subtitles.description: Burn dynamic animated subtitles (karaoke style) directly into video clips. Maximizes viewer retention on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

subtitle_style.title: Subtitle Style Preset
subtitle_style.description: Visual typography and color palette for animated karaoke subtitles.
enumTitles: Hormozi Style (Bold Yellow with High-Contrast Outline)

subtitle_position.title: Subtitle Vertical Position
subtitle_position.description: Vertical placement of subtitles on screen. 'Center' is optimized for TikTok/Reels safe-zone.

burn_hook_header.title: Burn Viral Hook Header Bar
burn_hook_header.description: Overlay a high-contrast headline banner showing the viral hook during the opening 4 seconds of each clip.

focus_topic.title: Topic / Keyword Focus
focus_topic.description: Optional theme or keyword filter (e.g. 'artificial intelligence', 'funny stories'). Directs AI to extract clips strictly related to this topic.

normalize_audio.title: Normalize Audio for Mobile (EBU R128)
normalize_audio.description: Normalize audio loudness to -14 LUFS standard for punchy, clear speech on mobile devices and social feeds.

generate_thumbnails.title: Generate High-Res Thumbnail Images
generate_thumbnails.description: Extract a high-resolution JPEG cover frame from the peak emotional moment of each clip and upload it to the Key-Value Store.

layout_mode.title: Video Layout & Composition Mode
layout_mode.description: Composition layout for vertical/social conversions. Supports standard center crop, podcast interview split stack, or blurred background bars.
enumTitles: Podcast Split Stack (Guest on Top, Host on Bottom)
Blurred Bars (Original Video with Blurred Background)

smart_face_tracking.title: Smart Face Tracking (Auto-Reframe)
smart_face_tracking.description: Automatically detect faces in video frames and adjust the vertical crop to track the primary speaker instead of a static center crop.

webhook_url.title: Webhook URL (Zapier / Make.com / Automation)
webhook_url.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS webhook URL. Sends a POST notification with complete clip URLs, titles, and social copy upon completion.
